language.label: Language
hosts.title: Hosts
host.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the list? Nothing changes on the host itself.
host.sandboxNote: A private network namespace with a demo firewall. Nothing done here touches a real firewall.
facts.title: System
access.sudoPasswordStored: Full access through sudo, with the password kept for this session
access.passwordHint: nftm keeps it in memory only while it runs and never saves it to disk.
access.noneTitle: nft cannot run as root on this host
access.noneHint: Log in as root, or allow this user to run nft with sudo.
access.nftMissing: nftables (the nft program) is not installed on this host
access.notAllowedTitle: sudo does not allow {{user}} to run nft
access.notAllowedHintGroup: As root, add {{user}} to the {{group}} group (usermod -aG {{group}} {{user}}), or allow nft for it in /etc/sudoers.d/. Group changes take effect after a new login.
access.notAllowedHint: As root, allow {{user}} to run nft with sudo, for example through the administrators group or a file in /etc/sudoers.d/. Group changes take effect after a new login.
access.restartNote: nftm keeps the groups of the session it was started from, so after the change start it again from a new login.
access.sudoMissingTitle: sudo is not installed on this host
access.sudoMissingHint: Log in as root, or install sudo and allow this user to run nft.
error.ssh-host-key.title: Unknown host key
error.ssh-host-key.hint: Connect once in a terminal with ssh {{destination}} and check the key fingerprint. Confirming keys in the panel is coming soon.
error.ssh-host-key-changed.title: The host key has changed
error.ssh-host-key-changed.hint: Someone may be intercepting the connection. Do not continue until the host's administrator confirms the new key.
error.ssh-auth.title: SSH login failed
error.ssh-auth.hint: nftm logs in with SSH keys or ssh-agent only. Check that ssh {{destination}} works in a terminal without asking for a password.
error.ssh-connect.title: Cannot reach the host
error.ssh-connect.hint: Check the address and the network, and that an SSH server runs on the host.
error.timeout.title: The host did not answer in time
error.spawn-failed.title: A required program is missing on this computer
error.wrong-password.title: Wrong password
error.invalid-host.title: This host cannot be added
error.timeout.hint: The host or the network may be slow or down. Try reconnecting.
error.spawn-failed.hint: The message below names the program nftm could not start.
error.command-failed.title: The command failed on the host
error.nft-missing.title: nftables (the nft program) is not installed on this host
error.no-privileges.title: nft cannot run as root on this host
error.password-required.title: Enter the sudo password first
error.wrong-password.hint: Check the password and the keyboard layout. After several failed attempts the system may lock the account for a while.
error.sudo-not-allowed.title: sudo refused to run nft for this user
error.host-state-changed.title: The host's state has changed
error.host-state-changed.hint: Reconnect to refresh it, then try again.
error.unauthorized.title: The session token is missing or no longer valid
error.unauthorized.hint: nftm creates a new token every time it starts. Open the URL it printed most recently.
error.internal-error.title: Internal error in nftm
error.internal-error.hint: The terminal where nftm runs shows more. Please report this error.
error.backend-unreachable.title: Cannot reach the nftm backend
error.backend-unreachable.hint: Check that nftm is still running in its terminal.
addHost.title: Add SSH host
addHost.destinationHint: For example admin@fw1.example.com, or a Host alias from ~/.ssh/config. nftm uses your SSH configuration, keys and agent.
addHost.name: Display name (optional)
